notes: List of the posted entries that the periodical-entry process (AC_DUPENTRY) copies: entries of the session company only, legacy serial NVL(MAX(NVL(SERIAL,1)),1)+1, entry must be a posted entry of an allowed journal, no duplicates, description taken from the entry (APP_RULES3_GL, see processes/AC_DUPENTRY_DEF.md)

rules.where: ((ENTRY_YEAR, ENTRY_TYPE, ENTRY_NO) in (select entry_year, entry_type, entry_no from ac_yearly_trn where create_company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE)) or (ENTRY_YEAR, ENTRY_TYPE, ENTRY_NO) in (select entry_year, entry_type, entry_no from ac_daily_trn where create_company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE)))

AC_PERIODICAL_VOC.TYPE_ENTRY_DESC.sql: (select max(case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(c.entry_desc_e, c.entry_desc) else c.entry_desc end) from ac_trn_codes c where c.entry_year = t.entry_year and c.entry_type = t.entry_type)
